known_limitations: Only screenshot-visible rows and cells are normalized; off-screen rows are not inferred.
Every selected scoreboard has partial troop-row visibility, so contribution-index or whole-army share metrics must not be inferred from this package.
White level-up icons and cursor-obscured numeric cells remain explicit review items rather than guessed values.
The 14:08 scoreboard is an in-progress state superseded by the final 14:28 result and is not a second independent battle.
The 18:20:32/33 and 00:27:44/48 pairs are duplicate captures of the same final results; one canonical image from each pair is selected.
The two 2026-08-13 Goldenheart PNG hashes exactly match the source already published in merged PR #69 and are excluded from this batch.
Raw PNG files are not retained in Git; filenames, sizes, per-image SHA-256 values, Library file IDs, selection status, and deterministic source hashes are recorded.
